data_description.dataset_name: SMAP L3 Radiometer Global Daily 9km Soil Moisture

spatial_coverage.region_name: Global land surface soil moisture coverage
spatial_coverage.coverage: Global daily composite of land surface soil moisture retrieved by SMAP L-Band radiometer. Covers all terrestrial areas not permanently frozen or covered with water.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Daily soil moisture measurements from 2015-04-01 to present in the Earth Engine asset.
data_description.total_samples: Continuous daily acquisition with 2-3 day global revisit

band_semantics.soil_moisture_am: Surface soil moisture from descending pass (6am local time, cm^3/cm^3)
band_semantics.soil_moisture_pm: Surface soil moisture from ascending pass (6pm local time, cm^3/cm^3)

data_description.important_note: SMAP measures liquid water in the top 5cm layer of soil everywhere on Earth not covered with water or frozen. It distinguishes between frozen and thawed ground. SMAP provides critical data for drought monitoring, agricultural planning, flood prediction, and climate studies. The mission started operation in April 2015 after radar component failure, continuing with radiometer-only measurements.
analytical_capabilities: Drought monitoring and early warning systems
Agricultural water stress assessment and crop yield prediction
Freeze-thaw state monitoring for high latitudes

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Soil moisture in cm^3/cm^3 (volumetric water content). Use soil_moisture_am for morning measurements and soil_moisture_pm for evening measurements.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Filter by retrieval quality flags and surface condition flags. Higher vegetation density reduces retrieval accuracy. Frozen ground is flagged separately.

data_description.data_source: NASA SMAP (Soil Moisture Active Passive) mission via Google Earth Engine
